name: Sukanta Nath
headline: Building Autonomous Systems — From Mars Rovers to Smart Factories
subheadline: Mechanical Engineering @ CUET · AI/ML · Autonomous Navigation · Computer Vision
about:
I'm a Mechanical Engineering student at CUET (CGPA 3.82) building at the intersection of physical systems and artificial intelligence. My trajectory has been deliberate: from mastering mechanical design and earning a SOLIDWORKS certification, to completing DeepLearning.AI's ML Specialization and co-founding a Mars Rover team targeting the University Rover Challenge 2027.

I work on problems where AI meets the real world — autonomous rover navigation using edge computing (Jetson Orin Nano), AI-powered service platforms, and industrial applications of computer vision. I've led cross-functional teams of 30+ members, placed in national AI hackathons, and maintained a merit scholarship for five consecutive semesters.

I'm now seeking graduate research opportunities in applied ML — particularly in autonomous systems, predictive manufacturing, and vision-based quality control.
